diluted.description: The percentage of every share fully diluted; left out when none is.

fully_diluted.description: Shares fully diluted: the shares issued and the options granted over them (FR-EQ-19). SAFEs and notes count once they convert (FR-EQ-18).

issued.description: Shares issued and held, a whole number.

mine.description: The caller's own holding: the holder they sign in as (linkContactMember).

options.description: The options recorded grants gave over the class by the day, not shares yet (FR-EQ-19); left out when none.

ownership.description: The percentage of every share issued; left out when none is.

votes.description: Their votes: the shares times their class's votes per share, exact.

voting.description: The percentage of every vote; left out when no share votes.
